events.event: BEI announced that 81 High Shareholding Concentration (HSC) stocks will be excluded from the IHSG calculation from 2 November 2026, with BBCA, BBRI and ASII gaining weight.
events.key_numbers: 81 HSC stocks · ~18% of IHSG weight · effective 2 Nov 2026 · constituent period to 29 Jan 2027 · BBCA 8.75% to 9% · BBRI 7.93% to 9% · ASII 3.35% to 4.15% · names incl. BREN, BYAN, DSSA
events.why_it_matters: About 18% of the index stops moving the IHSG, so the headline index will behave differently for ordinary investors.
events.spreading_evidence: Bisnis.com 26 Oct headline list; several outlets covering HSC

events.event: BEI expanded its HSC committee to nine members, adding five independent external members including a foreign investor representative, to improve credibility.
events.key_numbers: 9 members · 4 SRO + 5 independent · includes F. Chapman Taylor (ex-Capital Group), Joshua Arief Tanja (UBS Sekuritas), Prof. Mardiasmo
events.why_it_matters: A signal to MSCI and foreign investors that the stock-selection process is being made more transparent.

events.event: The rupiah closed weaker at Rp18,135 per US dollar on 26 October as oil prices rose and fiscal worries grew.
events.key_numbers: Rp18,135/USD (-0.30%, from Rp18,080) · JISDOR Rp18,116 · Brent US$116.20 on 23 Oct (highest since June 2022) · WTI US$102.50 · energy subsidy+compensation Rp376.8 T to Sep (+54.1% y/y) · ICP US$91.9 vs budget US$70 · each US$1 ICP ~Rp6.8 T deficit
events.why_it_matters: A weaker rupiah and pricier oil push up import costs and strain the budget that funds fuel subsidies.

events.event: Brent crude hit US$116.20 on 23 October, its highest since June 2022, on fears of renewed US strikes on Iran and Houthi attacks on Saudi Arabia.
events.key_numbers: Brent US$116.20 (+2.7%, +US$3.06) · ~+5% on week · WTI US$102.50 (+3.04%) · US ordered non-essential personnel out of Saudi Arabia
events.why_it_matters: Oil near US$116 raises pressure on Pertalite subsidies and the 2026 budget deficit.

events.event: Danantara COO Dony Oskaria said bankruptcy is not an option for Pos Indonesia, which has defaulted on bonds and sukuk, and that it will be restructured into a logistics holding.
events.key_numbers: Rp400 B bond (coupon unpaid 28 Sep) · Rp1 T sukuk (installments unpaid 18 Sep, 8 Oct) · Fitch D(idn) · assets Rp18.92 T (30 Jun 2025) · cash Rp3.49 T · ~4,000 distribution channels
events.why_it_matters: A state-owned company that handles mail and parcels for ordinary people has defaulted, raising questions on BUMN debt.

events.event: Bisnis.com reported Danantara will channel about Rp200 trillion of BUMN profits into investment rather than to the state budget (APBN).
events.key_numbers: Rp200 T BUMN profit to investment, not APBN (details not verified; article not retrievable)
events.why_it_matters: Money that used to be dividends to the budget now goes to Danantara's investments.

events.event: BEI scrapped trading suspensions to boost liquidity and OJK extended the buyback-without-RUPS policy to June 2027 (headlines only; articles not retrieved).
events.key_numbers: Buyback without RUPS extended to June 2027 · BEI removes stock trading suspension (details unverified)
events.why_it_matters: More market-support rules as Indonesia tries to head off the MSCI downgrade.

events.event: The IHSG weakened about 1.22% on 26 October, with BBCA to ANTM under pressure (close level and foreign flows not verified).
events.why_it_matters: The index gave back part of last week's 4.90% rebound.

events.event: The Finance Ministry opened the possibility that 2027 regional budget (APBD) deficits exceed the legal limit, under conditions (headline only; article blocked).
events.why_it_matters: Regional governments may borrow more as transfers tighten.

events.event: The US Fed FOMC meeting concludes on 28 October, with the rupiah and oil already under pressure.
events.key_numbers: FOMC 27-28 Oct · DXY expected 100.90-103.10 · rupiah seen towards Rp18,200
events.why_it_matters: A Fed decision can push the rupiah past Rp18,200.
